overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by listing an insufficiently specific executive session topic in its January 7 notice and by keeping inaccurate open session minutes, which it later revised. Convening procedure was proper.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the January 7 meeting notice listed an executive session topic too vaguely, citing only a statute section and a job-title abbreviation.
allegations.key_passage: this executive session topic was insufficiently detailed because it did not state under which specific purpose the Board intended to convene.

allegations.summary: Board argued the notice-specificity allegation was untimely because it was filed more than 30 days after the notice was posted.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that this allegation was timely filed with the Board.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the Board did not follow required procedures for convening in executive session on January 7.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board properly followed the procedural requirements for convening in executive session during its January 7 meeting, including the requirement that a roll call vote approve the closed door session.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the chair's pre-session announcement of the executive session topic was not detailed enough.
allegations.key_passage: The chair's verbal statement prior to convening in executive session- a recitation of the statutory language- provided as much detail about the topic as possible without compromising the purpose for which the executive session was called.

allegations.summary: Complaint said the original January 7 minutes did not accurately record the vote to enter executive session; the Board revised them after the complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Although the original minutes did not comply with these requirements, following its receipt of this Open Meeting Law complaint the Board revised the minutes to reflect the language of the actual vote taken by the Board.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
